findings.quote: I am, of course, talking about artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Introduces AI power, corporate control, rule setting and accountability by comparison with nuclear weapons.

findings.quote: This is precisely what makes AI so powerful, for better or for worse.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI risks, benefits, concentrated ownership and global responsibility.

findings.quote: How do we enable our international institutions to keep pace with the technologies that are reshaping our world?
findings.rationale: Continues the AI technological revolution discussion by asking how international institutions can keep pace and reform.

findings.quote: That is why Germany calls on UN member states to work towards common safety requirements for the most capable AI models.
findings.rationale: Proposes common AI safety requirements, pre-release testing, incident reporting and inclusive governance.

findings.quote: How we address AI together is one of the clearest tests whether we have the strength and the will to build a United Nations for today's world.
findings.rationale: Continues AI oversight and industry accountability proposals and emphasizes UN cooperation.
